title: Present Value Annuity (Loan Repayment)
body:
Mpho takes out a home loan of R850 000 at an interest rate of 11.25% per annum, compounded monthly. She agrees to repay the loan over 20 years with equal monthly payments.

Calculate the monthly repayment amount.

Present Value Annuity Formula: $P = x \cdot \frac{1 - (1+i)^{-n}}{i}$
